title: Scripture and Preaching
definition: Scripture and preaching belong together because biblical preaching declares, explains, applies, and exalts the Word of God.
summary: Preaching is the faithful proclamation of God's Word for conviction, comfort, and discipleship.
christFocus: Christ is proclaimed through Scripture-centered preaching as Savior, Lord, and hope.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Preaching is not the display of human opinion. Biblical preaching brings the Word of God to the people of God and calls for response before God.

Faithful preaching explains the text, proclaims Christ, corrects error, comforts the weary, warns the careless, and equips believers for obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People can gather for religious speech and still not hear God's Word faithfully preached. Scripture and preaching matters because the Church needs proclamation that is rooted in the text and centered on Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Listen to preaching with an open Bible and a humble heart. If you preach or teach, let the text govern the message and let Christ remain central.
